before.unresolvedReason: s0137 卒年六十 and s0147 軌卒 follow 湣帝即位 (建興元年 / AD 313) and 建興初. Inclusive 在州十三年 from 永甯元年 / AD 301 yields AD 313; the conventional Jianxing 2 death is AD 314. The chapter never writes 二年 for the death, so 313 and 314 stay competing.

sourceDate.text: 卒年六十；軌卒；在州十三年

after.event: Zhang Gui died at sixty sui; the province later asked Zhang Shi to hold his father's post. The conventional AD 314 year is supplied by the separate Book of Jin 5 annal, not by an explicit era-year in this biography: the Jianxing year-one heading reads 建興元年夏四月丙午，奉懷帝崩問，舉哀成禮。 (s0465), the next annual heading reads 二年春正月己巳朔，黑霧著人如墨，連夜，五日乃止。 (s0255), and that year's death entry reads 五月壬辰，太尉、領護羌校尉、涼州刺史、西平公張軌薨。 (s0264). Primary text: https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/晉書/卷005#建興二年 . The Ministry of Education Western Jin reign table gives Jianxing 1 as AD 313, so year 2 is conventional AD 314 (https://dict.revised.moe.edu.tw/appendix.jsp?ID=3&page=2&ver=0). The biography's tenure phrase 在州十三年 specifies no inclusive calendar counting rule; it is not an explicit competing AD 313 death year. No Gregorian month/day or birth year is inferred.
